notes.zh-CN: 回复里的表格不再把短标签列挤成一字一行的竖排：只有「卡点」「需要人审批」这类短标签的单元格保持单行，列宽由标签本身决定，正文列照常换行。表头加了浅底色并改为左对齐，与下方单元格对齐；多行单元格顶对齐，长表格读起来不再漂浮。
notes.en: Tables in replies no longer squeeze a short label column into one character per line: a cell holding only a short label such as 卡点 or 需要人审批 stays on one line, so the column keeps the label's width while prose cells still wrap. The header row gains a tint and reads left-aligned with the cells under it, and multi-line cells align to the top, so long tables scan cleanly.
